tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Thank you for speaking with me today. I'd like to ask you some questions about health. First, How do you usually maintain your physical health in your daily life?
tasks.analysis: 中文：谢谢您今天与我交流。我想问您几个关于健康的问题。首先，您在日常生活中通常如何保持身体健康？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Interesting. What kind of nutritional habits do you think are essential for a healthy lifestyle?
tasks.analysis: 中文：有意思。您认为哪些营养习惯对健康的生活方式是必不可少的？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Now, Some people believe that mental health is just as important as physical health, while others focus more on physical fitness. What is your opinion and why?
tasks.analysis: 中文：现在，有些人认为心理健康和身体健康同样重要，而另一些人则更关注身体素质。您的看法是什么？为什么？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Finally, do you think modern people have become more sedentary than before and should exercise more?
tasks.analysis: 中文：最后，您认为现代人是否比过去更加久坐不动，并且应该增加运动量？
tasks.title: Interview
